question_summary: Request clarification on required setback for excavation shoring near property line per Section 31 50 00 and whether the civil inspector can approve it as shown, since the geotechnical report is unclear.
referenced_documents: Spec Section 31 50 00 Excavation Support and Protection
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
